title: Keyboard Manager dual-key tap condition for single-key remaps

status.label: Review drafted
status.detail: The review iteration cap has already been exceeded. Four current, apply-ready suggestions address native boolean marshaling and hidden editor-condition state. Two reload-state concerns remain manual notes because their fixes require edits outside current diff ranges.

next_action: Recheck the upstream head, then post the selected suggestions only if the maintainer agrees; manually assess the remaining reload-state concerns.

confidence.rationale: The native export returns C++ bool, while the surrounding native-bool wrapper declarations use I1.

proposed_comments.title: Marshal the native bool lookup result as I1
proposed_comments.body:
### Marshal the native bool lookup result as I1

**Severity:** `high`

This export returns a C++ `bool`, not a four-byte Win32 `BOOL`. Matching the adjacent native-bool declarations prevents a failed lookup from being interpreted as success and exposing an uninitialized mapping.

```suggestion
        [DllImport(DllName, CallingConvention = Convention)]
        [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.I1)]
        internal static extern bool GetSingleKeyAloneRemap(IntPtr config, int index, ref SingleKeyMapping mapping);
```

confidence.rationale: The native add export returns C++ bool and the existing parallel add declarations marshal native bool as I1.

proposed_comments.title: Marshal the native key-remap add result as I1
proposed_comments.body:
### Marshal the native key-remap add result as I1

**Severity:** `high`

The native method returns a C++ `bool`. Using `I1` preserves a rejected add result instead of allowing the editor to treat a failed mapping insertion as successful.

```suggestion
        [DllImport(DllName, CallingConvention = Convention)]
        [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.I1)]
        internal static extern bool AddSingleKeyAloneRemap(IntPtr config, int originalKey, int targetKey);
```

confidence.rationale: The native shortcut add export returns C++ bool and has the same ABI contract as its neighboring native-bool declarations.

proposed_comments.title: Marshal the native shortcut-remap add result as I1
proposed_comments.body:
### Marshal the native shortcut-remap add result as I1

**Severity:** `high`

This native method also returns C++ `bool`, so it needs one-byte `I1` marshaling. That lets the editor reliably surface a rejected shortcut-valued Alone mapping.

```suggestion
        [DllImport(DllName, CallingConvention = Convention, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.I1)]
        internal static extern bool AddSingleKeyAloneToShortcutRemap(IntPtr config, int originalKey, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string targetKeys);
```

confidence.rationale: A collapsed condition control retains its prior selection, while the condition is only valid for visible single-key mappings.

proposed_comments.title: Return Always when the condition control is hidden
proposed_comments.body:
### Return Always when the condition control is hidden

**Severity:** `medium`

When a single-key trigger changes into a shortcut, the collapsed control retains its previous `Alone` selection. Returning `Always` while it is hidden prevents that stale value from being saved on a mapping type that does not support the condition.

```suggestion
        public KeyboardManagerEditorUI.Interop.SingleKeyRemapCondition GetCondition() =>
            ConditionComboBox?.Visibility == Visibility.Visible
                ? (KeyboardManagerEditorUI.Interop.SingleKeyRemapCondition)(ConditionComboBox.SelectedIndex ?? 0)
                : KeyboardManagerEditorUI.Interop.SingleKeyRemapCondition.Always;
```
